source: inbox/migrate-alchemy.md: the shared revert of two Fly sources stopped in reference planning with unsafe project output packages/fly/lib; protectedSources named lib/App.d.ts, lib/App.js, lib/AuthProvider.d.ts, lib/AuthProvider.js, lib/BindService.d.ts, lib/BindService.js, lib/Bootstrap.d.ts and lib/Bootstrap.js, none tracked.
